title: festuca valesiaca var. ganeschinii
intro: Festuca valesiaca var. ganeschinii, commonly known as alpine meadow grass or mountain fescue, is a plant species in the grass family Poaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exert a calming effect on the nervous system. Bioactive constituents of Festuca valesiaca var. ganeschinii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
